colors.description: Enable interpretation of \Z escape sequences in dialog text

color_mode.description: Extend color support to programbox/tailbox/textbox (use 2 for full support)

backtitle.description: Backtitle string displayed at top of screen behind dialogs

item_help.description: Show help text for currently selected list item

help_tags.description: Use item tags instead of item text in help output

default_item.description: Tag of default item in checklist/menu/form

default_button.description: Name of default button: ok, yes, cancel, no, help, extra

defaultno.description: Make 'No' the default in yesno boxes

no_items.description: Read list entries as tags only

visit_items.description: Include list items in tab traversal

cr_wrap.description: Interpret literal newlines as line breaks

ascii_lines.description: Use ASCII characters for box drawing

date_format.description: strftime format for calendar widget output

time_format.description: strftime format for timebox widget output

column_separator.description: Separator to split list data into columns

separate_widget.description: Separator between chained widgets in output

tab_len.description: Tab width when tab-correct is enabled

week_start.description: First day of week: 0-6 (Sun-Sat), 'locale', or abbreviation (Mo,Tu...)

iso_week.description: Use ISO week numbering (start week on Monday, first week with Thursday)

color_list.description: Color definitions for curses colors 0-7 (black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white). Must be exactly 8 entries if provided.

key_bindings.description: List of custom key bindings for widgets. Each binding defines widget, curses_key, and dialog_key.
